# Town of Pawlet municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 17; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Pawlet, Certificate of Votes, March 3, 2026 Australian-ballot election (attested by Town Clerk Debra A. Hawkins, March 4, 2026; 297 votes cast): John C. Thrasher was elected moderator with 282 votes

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists the Pawlet selectboard: Michael Beecher (Chair), Bob Jones (Vice Chair), Tom Collard, Richard Hulett, and Jessica Van Oort

Town of Pawlet, Certificate of Votes, March 3, 2026 Australian-ballot election (attested by Town Clerk Debra A. Hawkins, March 4, 2026; 297 votes cast): Robert Jones was elected to a three-year seat with 257 votes, and Tom Collard (241) and Jessica Van Oort (203) to one-year seats; Michael Beecher and Richard Hulett did not stand and continue

Town of Pawlet, Certificate of Votes, March 3, 2026 Australian-ballot election (attested by Town Clerk Debra A. Hawkins, March 4, 2026; 297 votes cast): Debra Hawkins was elected town clerk for a three-year term with 286 votes
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Debra Hawkins as Pawlet's town clerk

Town of Pawlet, Certificate of Votes, March 3, 2026 Australian-ballot election (attested by Town Clerk Debra A. Hawkins, March 4, 2026; 297 votes cast): Julie Mach was elected town treasurer for a three-year term with 278 votes
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Julie Mach as Pawlet's town treasurer

Town of Pawlet, 2025 Town Report: 'our two constables: Thomas Covino ... or Mark Gutel'; the only constable seat on the certified 2026 certificate was the Second Constable seat, so Covino holds the First Constable seat, which did not stand in 2026

Town of Pawlet, Certificate of Votes, March 3, 2026 Australian-ballot election (attested by Town Clerk Debra A. Hawkins, March 4, 2026; 297 votes cast): Mark Gutel was elected second constable for a two-year term with 254 votes

Town of Pawlet, Certificate of Votes, March 3, 2026 Australian-ballot election (attested by Town Clerk Debra A. Hawkins, March 4, 2026; 297 votes cast): Kimberly A. Ayers was elected collector of delinquent taxes for a one-year term with 281 votes

Town of Pawlet, Certificate of Votes, March 3, 2026 Australian-ballot election (attested by Town Clerk Debra A. Hawkins, March 4, 2026; 297 votes cast): Phoebe McChesney (238 votes) and Amy B. Miller (220 votes) were elected library trustees to three-year terms; the board's size is five under 22 V.S.A. section 143 per the library's own meeting record, and the other three seats' holders are published in no current official source, so they are created without memberships

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): Pawlet elects seven justices of the peace; the listing names Leon Corey, Beth Moser Duquette, Raymond Duquette Sr., Sue LaPorte, John Malcolm, Bradley Myerson, and Carol Schoenwetter
